premise: A high school boy who is good at everything he tries and bored of it all, until his whole class is summoned to another world.

draft.premise: A high school boy who is good at everything he tries and bored of it all, until his whole class is summoned to another world.

world.title: Summoned Boredom
world.era: Aethelgard: medieval fantasy with a magical status system

extraordinary.reach: Spells can level fortresses at the highest tiers, but require immense mana and chants.
Governs levels, stats, and classes for all sapient beings in Aethelgard.

rules.text: Every living being possesses a Status Screen visible to themselves and high-tier mages.
Souls summoned from other worlds are granted unique cheat skills or high-tier classes.
Mana is replenished naturally through rest, meditation, or potion consumption.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.description: The dominant species of Solaria, versatile and ambitious.
peoples.culture: Feudal kingdom structure with a heavy reliance on magical classes.
relations: At war with the Demon Kingdom to the north.

creatures.name: Mana Beast
creatures.description: Wild creatures mutated by high concentrations of ambient mana.
creatures.worth: Mana cores used for crafting and enchanting.

nature: Mana flows through the earth like water, pooling in ancient ruins and dungeons.

rungs.name: Novice Adventurer
rungs.description: Levels 1 to 10. Just learning to wield basic skills.

rungs.name: Iron Class
rungs.description: Levels 11 to 30. Competent fighters and mages.

rungs.name: Silver Class
rungs.description: Levels 31 to 50. Veterans who lead parties.

rungs.name: Gold Class
rungs.description: Levels 51 to 75. Kingdom-level assets and champions.

rungs.name: Heroic Class
rungs.description: Levels 76 to 99. Legends capable of fighting demon commanders.

rungs.name: Transcendent
rungs.description: Level 100+. Demigods whose power defies the System's normal limits.

travel.description: Travel is done on foot, by horse-drawn carriage, or via expensive royal teleportation gates.

medicine.healing: Holy magic and herbal potions can mend bones in seconds, though scars remain without high-tier spells.

laws.text: All summoned heroes must register with the Solarian Crown and assist in the national defense.

places.name: Kingdom of Solaria
places.description: A vast, prosperous kingdom known for its towering white-stone cities and powerful mage academies.

places.name: Solaria Capital City
places.description: The bustling heart of the kingdom, built around the massive Royal Palace.

places.name: Solaria Royal Palace
places.description: A monumental castle of white marble and gold spires, housing the royal family and their guard.

places.name: Grand Summoning Chamber
places.description: A secure subterranean chamber deep beneath the palace, inscribed with massive, glowing spatial runes.

factions.name: The Crown of Solaria
factions.description: The ruling royal family and noble council of Solaria, desperate to win the war against the Demon King.
factions.goal: Utilize the summoned class to defeat the Demon King's vanguard.
factions.methods: Coercion, royal hospitality, and intensive training regimens.
factions.strength: Thousands of elite knights, high mages, and control over regional dungeons.

factions.name: Class 2-B
factions.description: A group of thirty Japanese high school students suddenly yanked from their ordinary lives.
factions.goal: Find a way to survive this strange world and return home.
factions.methods: Sticking together, developing their newly granted cheat classes, and cooperating with the royalty.
factions.strength: Potentially limitless growth due to otherworldly soul status blessings.

npcs.name: King Aldus Solaria
npcs.description: A weary, stern ruler carrying the weight of a crumbling empire on his shoulders.
npcs.appearance: An older man with sharp grey eyes, a neatly trimmed silver beard, wearing heavy golden ceremonial robes.

wants: to turn the summoned teenagers into military assets
temperament.voice: Deep, commanding, and laced with absolute authority.

agenda.goal: Bind the class by magical oath before they realize their own power.
agenda.method: Offering them immediate knighthood, fine food, and prestige.
agenda.secret: Solaria's armies are on the verge of total collapse.

secrets: The border fortress fell three days ago, which triggered this desperate ritual.

npcs.name: Princess Elara
npcs.description: A compassionate princess who hates that children were torn from their home for Solaria's war.
npcs.appearance: A young woman with long golden hair, gentle green eyes, dressed in flowing blue silk and silver jewelry.

wants: to help the summoned students adjust safely
temperament.voice: Soft, melodic, but carrying an underlying strength.

agenda.goal: Prevent her father from throwing the students straight into battle.
agenda.method: Secretly informing the students of their potential and helping them unlock their systems.
agenda.secret: She is looking for a hero strong enough to change Solaria's corrupt system from within.

secrets: She deliberately modified the summoning runes to ensure the heroes received higher potential blessings.

npcs.name: Hiroyuki Tanaka
npcs.description: The earnest, slightly anxious class representative trying to keep his panicked classmates together.
npcs.appearance: A neat-looking teenager with short black hair, wearing his school uniform with a slightly rumpled tie.

wants: to establish communication with the locals and keep everyone safe
temperament.voice: Slightly strained but polite and clear.

clocks.name: The Royal Assessment
steps: The King demands their allegiance and explains their status as heroes.
The royal mages perform a status screen evaluation of every student.
A combat trial is conducted in the palace training grounds to test their blessings.
The students are assigned military ranks and locked into their training quarters.

threads.title: A New World, A Bored Soul
threads.stakes: Find something in this magical world that finally challenges you, while navigating the kingdom's machinations.

mysteries.question: Is there a way for Class 2-B to return back to Earth?
mysteries.answer: Yes, but the summoning ritual was heavily modified. Reversing it requires the 'Key of Worlds' hidden inside the ancient Abyss Dungeon, which is currently occupied by high-level demonic forces.
clues: A hint from Princess Elara about hidden spatial archives.
An ancient mural in the palace basement depicting a gateway with a key-like artifact.
A cryptic warning from the system's hidden logs.

known_facts: You were sitting in homeroom, completely bored out of your mind, when a giant magical seal appeared under your desks.
The people who summoned you claim you are 'Heroes' destined to save Solaria.

positions: Your classmates are panicking and crying all around you.
King Aldus stands on a raised dais, looking down at the class with critical eyes.
Princess Elara watches you from the shadows of the pillars, a look of profound guilt on her face.
opening.situation: The blinding flash of the summoning circle fades, replacing your dull classroom with a cold stone hall of armed knights, royal court members, and a king demanding your service.

world.summary: A talented but perpetually bored high schooler is summoned along with his entire class to a fantasy world desperate for heroes. While his classmates panic, he finally sees a chance to escape his mind-numbing boredom using his incredible natural genius.

character.name: Ren Kusanagi
character.description: An incredibly sharp, detached teenager who maintains a calm, almost lazy demeanor in the face of absolute chaos.
character.appearance: Tall, with messy black hair, dark eyes that rarely show excitement, and a slightly loose-fitting high school uniform.

skills.name: Observation
skills.notes: He spots details, tells, and flaws instantly.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.notes: Highly coordinated, though he rarely puts in maximum effort.

skills.name: Logic
skills.notes: Solves complex intellectual problems with ease.

traits.name: Perpetually Bored
traits.description: Standard challenges fail to excite him, making him indifferent to common threats unless they pique his genuine curiosity.

traits.name: Absolute Adaptability
traits.description: His mind and body adjust to hostile or novel environments with freakish speed.

talents.name: Effortless Mastery
talents.covers: any physical, mental, or magical technique he attempts for the first time.
talents.reason: Because he is a natural genius who has spent his entire life mastering things instantly and getting bored of them.

powers.name: System Anomaly
limits: He cannot directly edit his basic stats, only bypass class requirements and view hidden logs.

temperament.voice: Casual, slightly slow, and entirely unbothered.

items.name: School Uniform
items.description: Your standard black high school blazer and trousers. Offers no real protection.

items.name: Smartphone
items.description: An Earth device with no cellular connection, but the flashlight, camera, and basic offline apps still work.

character.title: Otherworldly Soul

connections.name: Class 2-B
connections.note: Your classmates who were summoned alongside you.

backstory: You lived an exceptionally easy life where everything came naturally to you: academics, sports, arts. Because nothing was ever a struggle, you grew incredibly bored.
Just as you were wondering if your entire life would be this dull, the summoning circle appeared under your classroom desk.
